purpose: Extend the inactive three-session research reserve during Candidate49 prospective observation with economically interpretable mechanism concepts that use only the accepted close/volume/amount minute schema, without assigning a candidate ordinal, freezing a formula or direction, computing values, or reading prices and returns.

future_only_policy.candidate50_activation_condition: candidate49 is terminally rejected or completes its full 200-signal evaluation

queue_delta_semantics.required_next_step_for_one_entry: Only after Candidate49 satisfies the activation condition and all earlier still-distinct entries are resolved, perform a fresh no-value mechanism-overlap audit for exactly one entry, then freeze one exact formula and direction before any value computation.

inactive_append_only_entries.mechanism: Study whether substantial CNY trading activity can be absorbed while the observed minute close remains unchanged, as a possible liquidity-resilience or hidden-distribution mechanism.
inactive_append_only_entries.economic_question: Does unusually strong transaction activity without an immediate close update contain three-session information that is not already represented by price-update frequency or broad amount concentration?
known_design_risks: minimum price tick and stale-close mechanics can mimic absorption
price-limit or halt-adjacent rows may dominate the concept
the economically plausible direction is ambiguous before a separate preregistration
multiple possible activity normalizations would create formula search

inactive_append_only_entries.mechanism: Isolate repricing across the midday non-trading interval and examine whether the subsequent afternoon path confirms or rejects that repricing.
inactive_append_only_entries.economic_question: Does information incorporated between the morning close and afternoon reopening persist over the next three sessions, independently of generic late return, terminal location, or full-day volatility allocation?
known_design_risks: the exact 11:30 and 13:01 bar-label semantics must remain accepted
a one-transition signal may be noisy and sparse after quality gates
confirmation and rejection variants would create post-hoc direction search
the concept may collapse into an afternoon momentum or reversal synonym

inactive_append_only_entries.mechanism: Compare the observed price response per unit of CNY activity on negative and positive within-session price moves as a possible asymmetry in sell-side versus buy-side liquidity.
inactive_append_only_entries.economic_question: Does a stock absorb one direction of price pressure more efficiently than the other in a way that remains informative for the next three sessions?
known_design_risks: small activity or return denominators can make ratios unstable
choice of return transformation and aggregation can create formula search
price-limit sessions can induce mechanical asymmetry
the economically plausible direction is ambiguous before a separate preregistration

research_boundary.files_read_for_this_delta: frozen policy/state, existing mechanism queue and records, minute source/cleaning schema metadata only

decision.next_action_before_candidate49_terminal_: Continue Candidate49 prospective collection and paper settlement only; preserve this append-only concept delta without computing any of its values.
decision.next_action_after_activation_condition: Resolve the original queue in order. Only if priorities one through three are retired or consumed may priority four receive a fresh no-value overlap audit; no later entry may bypass an earlier still-distinct entry.
